production-regions-bid-rent.alt: A graph. The vertical axis is the rent a farmer can pay for a hectare of land; the horizontal axis is distance from the market. Three falling lines: market gardening starts highest and falls fastest, grain starts in the middle and falls more slowly, ranching starts lowest and falls slowest. A colored band under the axis shows which use can pay the most at each distance: market gardening nearest the market, then grain, then ranching farthest away.
